calm.blocks_next_point: Once a lesson starts, every open exercise has three rows under it: a five-link toolbar (Hint, I'm lost, I don't know, Photo, Symbols), a second input ('Or write on the page'), and an Esc hint. On top of that comes filler like 'Your earlier days will be here.' (window/s2-answer-dark). The cold page is almost empty; the lesson page is not.

flexible.blocks_next_point: Where I type decides what a message is: the exercise line takes answers, the page line takes talk. And after two changes in my turn, the agenda header said 'Moved from Sun 22 Nov' while the page line said 'was Sun 6 Dec'.

craft.blocks_next_point: Markdown and LaTeX leak onto the page: stray '**' paragraphs and a trailing '**' in the real lesson (live/s2-answer-dark, live/s4-return-dark), and raw '$V_{max}$' in the course sheet (shots/course-dark). performance.blocks_next_point: Startup is 628–700 ms in window/ (827 ms in my turn, 1029 ms for live's week run). Keystroke to paint is median 17 ms and p95 19 ms. That is good, but just over one 60 Hz frame, and startup is still above the half second a native editor manages.

still_dislike: ⌘K doesn't put the cursor in its search field (focus lands on Close), and pressing Return on a focused option in Settings didn't apply it. The keyboard-first promise breaks exactly in the sheets.
The page isn't mine past a short menu: five system faces, light or dark, two line lengths. I can't name my own installed font, load a colour theme, or rebind a key. The Keys list is read-only.

Tutor Markdown and LaTeX leak as raw text ('**' lines in the real lesson, '$V_{max}$' in the course sheet, 'K m' in the stop line). On a page meant to be my own material, that's the first thing that looks broken.

window_turn: I got the lock after a 461 s wait and found the window mid-lesson from earlier judges. I drove it by keyboard only. ⌘N, 'TEACH', Return: the line went in as an answer inside the open standard-error exercise, and the tutor then posed 'What is b in x² − 5x + 6 = 0?'. 'b = 5' + Return: grey 'not right' in the left margin. ⌘⇧H: sent a faint 'Can I have a hint?' and the hint came back. 'b = -5': green 'right / with a hint' beside it. Esc moved to the page line. 'change the plan, I want to do hypothesis tests first': the agenda reordered in place with 'moved up'/'moved down', the date became Sun 13 Dec, and a green timed 'The plan changed…' line was written from the record. 'by the way, what does a p-value of 0.03 really mean?' came back unmarked, and 'back to the task' reopened the exercise with its answer line. ⌘, opened Settings; Tab moved through the options with a clear focus ring, but Return on Iowan did not apply it. ⌘= applied size 19 at once and ⌘− put it back. ⌘K opened Commands with focus on Close, so I couldn't type to filter. ⌘P opened the full plan sheet. Measured typing latency: median 17 ms, p95 19 ms, max 20; startup 827 ms. I released the lock afterwards.
